purpose: Audit P7C flow edges without modifying the P7C source cards.

constraints: declared_derivation records the P7C derivation claim (or legacy evidence_strength) and is never used as the final review decision.
derivation and review_status are independent fields.
review_status=pending may be retrieval eligible but is never answer eligible.
P7C-declared or P7D-reviewed llm_inference edges remain pending until a human decision is applied.
The edge review does not replace or mutate the source P7C edge.
card_result is pass only when structure_status is pass and every flow edge is accepted.
card_result is a summary and does not erase edge-level accepted, pending, or rejected decisions.
Human decisions append a new event and do not rewrite earlier LLM events.

decision_policy.automatic_accept: All semantic checks are supported, LLM recommendation is accepted, and neither declared nor reviewed derivation is llm_inference.
decision_policy.automatic_reject: Any node, direction, condition, qualifier, or parallel/correlation check is unsupported, or derivation is unsupported.
decision_policy.pending: Evidence is ambiguous, the LLM recommendation is pending, or either declared or reviewed derivation is llm_inference.
decision_policy.human_queue: All pending llm_inference edges enter the human review queue.
decision_policy.final_answer: Only accepted edges may support procedural assertions such as first, next, must, prohibited, or conditional routing.
